resource: Missions of one quest line (domain 16 QuestLineV1)
allocation_impact: Measured 87 (Killing in the Name Of), the largest of 529 missions in 58 quests. A quest with more missions does not load; a line with more fails closed in the codec.
boundary_tests: max=128: a line of 128 missions encodes and decodes
max+1=129: a 129th mission fails closed both ways
notes: QUEST-GATE-0 §9 (measured by QUEST-LOG-WIRE-1). Measured over content/quests/definitions (58 storyline quests with missions, 529 missions) from each mission's name and the longest journal text reference length, a template counted with 20 bytes per placeholder. Tests: quest_log::tests::a_line_holds_128_missions_within_its_byte_bound_and_refuses_more, quest::log::tests::a_catalogue_over_the_bounds_does_not_load. Registered by OTV2-20261004-quest-log-wire-1.
